extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: baby grand piano, case 1.49 x 1.60 m, 1.77 m long with keyboard, rim height 0.98 m, keys at 0.72 m; bench 0.76 x 0.36 x 0.52 m
extras.notes: 88 keys (52 white, 36 black, A0-C8); black lacquer with walnut inner rim, spruce soundboard, pastel-gold cast plate with struts, overstrung strings (wound bass in brass), bridges, dampers, tuning pins, music desk, three legs with brass casters, lyre with three pedals. Movable: 'grand-piano_lid' (origin on the hinge along the straight bass side; delivered open 32 degrees with the front flap folded back; rotate +32 degrees about the hinge axis (Blender local Y) to close), 'grand-piano_stick' (lid prop, origin at its foot on the rim), 'grand-piano_fallboard' (key cover, origin on its lower front edge; rotate +90 degrees about local X to close over the keys). Bench is a separate object. No text, no logo.

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
